timeline.summary: Honeywell Automation extended CFO Pulkit Goyal's tenure to May 20, 2026 for operational continuity.
HAIL Mauritius Limited, via **Boopendradas Sungker (Authorised Signatory)**, declares no encumbrance on its 6,631,142 shares of Honeywell Automation India Limited as of March 31, 2026.
Honeywell Automation India reported FY26 revenue of ₹4,681.9 Cr and net profit of ₹525.0 Cr, recommending a dividend of ₹110 per share.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,223.9 Cr (+6.5% YoY), net profit ₹133.7 Cr (+11.9% YoY).
